description: This file defines classes and functions for tracking and managing subscription WebSocket connections related to order tracking in a food delivery platform. It implements pub/sub functionality with an in-memory hub, designed for a single backend process.

classes.name: TrackingMessage
classes.description: Data class representing messages sent to tracking subscribers, including message type and payload.

classes.name: TrackingHub
classes.description: In-memory pub/sub hub managing WebSocket subscriptions by order ID. Provides methods to subscribe, unsubscribe, and publish messages to subscribers.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializer for TrackingHub, sets up lock and subscription dictionary.

methods.name: None subscribe(self, order_id: UUID, ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: Adds a WebSocket connection to the set of subscribers for a specific order ID.

methods.name: None unsubscribe(self, order_id: UUID, ws: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from the set of subscribers for a specific order ID.

methods.name: None publish(self, order_id: UUID, message: TrackingMessage)
methods.description: Sends a message to all WebSocket subscribers associated with a specific order ID, handling dead connections.

ctags.name: publish
ctags.pattern: /^    async def publish(self, order_id: UUID, message: TrackingMessage) -> None:$/

ctags.name: subscribe
ctags.pattern: /^    async def subscribe(self, order_id: UUID, ws: WebSocket) -> None:$/

ctags.name: unsubscribe
ctags.pattern: /^    async def unsubscribe(self, order_id: UUID, ws: WebSocket) -> None:$/
